The '''Rirsack system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rirsack]].
